After the stun applies once, it cannot affect the same target again for a while, so counterattack or escape during that window. Cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s awakening ends.
Udyr.teamfight: Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at an entry point, then cast Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from a blind spot after an ally lands an immobilizing effect first or Udyr's key response ability is down. After landing, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to slow and silence, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on anyone who can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. Target the weaker enemies behind Udyr first instead of the Udyr made durable by defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle.
Udyr.laning: In the jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain your health and clear speed. Track Udyr’s route with vision at key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push forward recklessly when he’s missing. For ganks, circle in from outside enemy vision and look to trigger fear automatically.
Udyr.phase: Early on, gank success depends on approaching from outside vision and triggering fear automatically, so watch for Udyr’s approach and keep your jungle route steady. In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core item, you can turn teamfights around with an approach from outside vision. Keep opening objective fights in the late game, but choose a spot where enemies will not spread out after you engage.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it is charged and closes the gap with a dash, so move backward or sideways to dodge when you see her charging. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target all the way and knocks them up, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash; once you land and the knock-up ends, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to create distance.
Vi.build: Build armor first because Vi’s main damage is physical. If her burst is strong, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to weather the focus fire right after you engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Vi.fight: Don’t let Vi W Denting Blows hit you with repeated attacks for long; fight briefly, then create distance. The moment after you dodge or make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to engage; use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify then to stop her counterattack. Don’t start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist can interrupt it.
Vi.escape: The moment after you dodge or make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker is your window to go in. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, don’t waste Fiddlesticks Q Terrify while she is charging toward you; use it after the landing and knock-up have ended.
Vi.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with an engage once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.
Vi.teamfight: Send out Scarecrow Effigy first to check vision and Vi’s position, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from beyond a wall or from a brush outside vision. Once responses such as Vi Q Vault Breaker or Vi R Cease and Desist are down, or an ally has landed an immobilizing effect first, engage into narrow terrain where several enemies are grouped.
Vi.combo: If Vi Q Vault Breaker has just been used, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, silence enemies in the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap, cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on Vi if she can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
Vi.laning: During your early jungle route, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain your health and clear speed. For ganks, approach through an unwarded brush or a blind spot by the river and look to trigger fear automatically. If Vi approaches with her shield up, fight after it is gone.

Warwick.build: In the early game, build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to account for the damage and healing from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. If healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain grievous wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Warwick.combo: For ganks, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap from outside vision to trigger the passive fear, and start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest during that window. Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify for right after Warwick moves with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress, or to finish him off. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the target who can retaliate, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Look for a window before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back, and close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has also been used. Then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to keep Warwick from escaping.
Warwick.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with a single engage once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening engages in fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.
Warwick.teamfight: Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision and choose an entry point in narrow terrain where several enemies are grouped. Once an ally has landed an immobilizing effect first or key responses such as Warwick E Primal Howl and Warwick R Infinite Duress are down, use Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision. After landing, stop counterattacks with Fiddlesticks E Reap and Fiddlesticks Q Terrify, and protect the Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest channel until it ends.
Warwick.fight: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don't pour out damage; keep your distance until his fear has been used. Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Warwick moves with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress to limit his chance to escape. Use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest after first lowering the enemy's health, and only when you can maintain the channel to the end.
Warwick.watch: Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you and leaves you unable to act, so keep a generous distance in mind and dodge its leap. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and triggers fear, so back off and fight after his fear has been used. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and speeds Warwick up, so don't stay in the jungle for long.
Warwick.laning: In the jungle, group monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap and channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end to maintain your health and move on to the next camp. For ganks, approach through an unwarded brush or blind spot and look to trigger fear automatically. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so give up a little farming and recall.

Viego.watch: The stun from Viego W Spectral Maw lasts longer the more it is charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging, and interrupt it with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify if he is in range. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, Viego may be camouflaged there, so avoid that path. When your health is low, move back because you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If you’re focused right after engaging, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to preserve the damage over time from Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. If healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King is a problem, get Morellonomicon.
Viego.combo: Save Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to catch Viego after he moves with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, or to interrupt Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge. In teamfights, engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from outside vision and hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end when you can protect the channel.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Close the gap with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in the window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, when Viego also cannot use the stun from Viego W Spectral Maw. Then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to deny Viego time to escape.
Viego.phase: In mid game, you can turn a teamfight around with an engage from outside vision once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and your ability power core items. In late game, keep opening fights around objectives, but choose a spot where the enemy team cannot scatter.
Viego.fight: Don't force small skirmishes where Viego can benefit from a takedown. From out of sight, deal damage first to apply fear, then fight after lowering Viego's health when you can channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest first if Viego W Spectral Maw could interrupt its channel with a stun.
Viego.teamfight: Before an objective or teamfight, use Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow to check vision at your entry point, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm over a wall or in a brush. Engage into a tight space where several enemies are grouped after an ally lands an immobilizing effect or a response ability such as Viego W Spectral Maw is down. If an ally falls, don't keep fighting there; pin Viego with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify so he can't reach the Wraith.
Viego.laning: For your early jungle path, group the monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end. For ganks, circle in from outside enemy vision to trigger the automatic fear. If the lane is warded, clear the vision or go to another lane. Don’t force your way in from a direction where you can see the mist from Viego E Harrowed Path.

Zac.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zac's damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If his healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Zac.fight: If Zac's knock-up could interrupt your W, wait it out. Then damage him and channel all the way through.
Zac.laning: In the jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Approach ganks along routes hidden from enemy vision. If a lane has a Control Ward, ask for it to be cleared or rotate to another lane.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is your chance to engage. If the opponent's key response abilities are also down, close the distance from out of vision with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and lock Zac down with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Zac.teamfight: Use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point, then cast Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in tight terrain after Zac engages or uses his key response abilities. Right after landing, aim to silence with the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap, cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the necessary target, then keep Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest from being interrupted. If Zac revives and his split blobs come close, deal with the blobs together using area damage.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing in and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify or the central silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap. If Zac gets on you, you'll take max-health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, so create distance after weathering his engage and step on the blobs he leaves behind to destroy them.
Zac.phase: Fiddlesticks’ early ganks depend on terrain and his automatic fear, so prioritize approaching unseen. In the mid game, engages with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and an ability power core become stronger, and he still plays a role in starting objective fights in the late game. The available information isn’t enough to determine whether Zac or Fiddlesticks is stronger in the early, mid, or late game.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the subsequent thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. Be especially careful because being hit by the thrust increases Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge's engage range. If you've been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's empowered attacks, get out of range before the third attack knocks you up.
XinZhao.build: Prioritize armor against Xin Zhao's main damage. Keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If you're focused right after engaging, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
XinZhao.fight: Deal damage from out of vision to trigger your passive fear, then catch Xin Zhao with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used. Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third attack or the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard could interrupt it. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active and damage from outside its boundary won't work, create distance and wait out its duration before counterattacking.
XinZhao.laning: In the early jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. Start ganks from out of vision by looping behind the lane through a brush or a blind spot by the river. If a lane is under enemy vision, ask an ally to clear it or rotate to another lane.
XinZhao.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge or when finishing him off.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you bait Xin Zhao into using Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. Delay your engage if Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third attack could reach and interrupt you. There's also an opening to counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.phase: From the mid game, once Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core Ability Power items are ready, one engage can turn a team fight around. Keep starting objective team fights in the late game, and look to counterattack the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: First, use Scarecrow Effigy to check vision at your entry point. Prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm where enemies are grouped and have little room to retreat. Engage after an ally's immobilizing effect lands or Xin Zhao uses his key response abilities. After landing, use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap to stop counterattacks and keep Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest channeling to the end.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, so if she gets close, dodge by turning sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, incoming damage is greatly reduced, so save Fiddlesticks' damage abilities until it ends.
Belveth.build: Consider armor first, since Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage. If you're hit by concentrated fire right after engaging, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If Bel'Veth's healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.fight: If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, don't unload your damage; wait for it to end. Don't start Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest if Bel'Veth W Above and Below could interrupt it.
Belveth.laning: In the jungle, use Fiddlesticks E Reap to group monsters and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. In the early game, before Bel'Veth builds stacks, delay her growth by stealing camps and large monsters during encounters where you have vision. Approach ganks by circling around outside enemy vision. If a lane has a Control Ward, clear the vision or head to another lane.
Belveth.combo: Use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right after Bel'Veth moves with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, or when finishing her off.
Belveth.escape: Dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below prevents her Bel'Veth Q Void Surge reset, so look for a chance to engage. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, but they come back quickly. Don't go in just because she has used it once; look for a chance to lock her down with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify before it comes back. Prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from out of enemy vision.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth is weakest early, before she has stacks, so hinder her growth by contesting her early camps and large monsters. Fiddlesticks can still start objective team fights with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in the late game, but Bel'Veth's permanent stacks put you at an increasing disadvantage as the game goes on.
Belveth.teamfight: Before a teamfight, use Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow to check vision at your entry point, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm where several enemies are grouped and there's little room to retreat. Engage after an ally lands an immobilizing effect or Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down, and use Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest without interruption. If an ally falls and a Void Coral appears, retreat before Bel'Veth can collect it, and delay the teamfight while she is transformed.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, don't run in a straight line along its trail; change your angle and move toward an ally or turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if the tether stays connected, so create distance to break it. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, casting Fiddlesticks Q Terrify right away will be blocked and greatly increase Nocturne's attack speed. If Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don't get isolated; move toward your allies immediately.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If you need to survive his burst, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, pop the spell shield first with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Damage Nocturne first, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest all the way through when you can, to get its final damage and healing. After Nocturne R Paranoia is used, you have a chance to close the distance with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and catch him with Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Nocturne.combo: Open ganks from out of vision with Fiddlesticks E Reap to trigger your passive fear, then channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, pop the spell shield first with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then use Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. In team fights, engage from out of vision with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, hit with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then cast Fiddlesticks Q Terrify on the target who can counterattack immediately and fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia is unavailable, Fiddlesticks has a window to go in. Break the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and remove Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. Start Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from a spot with no enemy vision while Nocturne's key response abilities are down.
Nocturne.phase: Nocturne has no Nocturne R Paranoia during this window, so you can look for an opening without worrying about that dash. In the mid game, once you have Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm and core Ability Power items, one engage can turn a team fight around. You can still start objective team fights in the late game, but Fiddlesticks is easy to kill if the enemies scatter after you engage.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia plunges the map into darkness, group with your allies to make it harder for Nocturne to pick an isolated target. Use Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow to check vision at your planned entry point, then prepare Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm in a tight area where several enemies are grouped. Engage after an ally lands an immobilizing effect or Nocturne's key response ability is down. After landing, use Fiddlesticks E Reap and Fiddlesticks Q Terrify to suppress retaliation, then maintain Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to the end.
Nocturne.laning: In the early jungle, group the monsters with Fiddlesticks E Reap, then fully channel Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to maintain your health and clear speed. For ganks, approach through a brush or river blind spot outside enemy vision to trigger the automatic fear. If a lane has a Control Ward, ask an ally to clear it or go to another lane. Secure vision around the river and jungle entrances, and decide where you can retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated.
